articles.title: Armadillo-Inspired Robot Rolls Into a Protective Ball
articles.summary: Engineers built a soft robot that copies the three-banded armadillo's famous trick: curling into a hard ball. When it senses a touch, it locks into a wheel in about a minute to protect fragile electronics.

articles.title: Fat Bear Week Returns for Its 12th Year
articles.summary: Fat Bear Week is back! Fans worldwide are voting for the chubbiest brown bear in Alaska's Katmai National Park. This year, 16 bears compete — including a mom raising three cubs and a returning champion.

articles.title: Service Star: Abhijay Potluri, 14, Teaches Coding Worldwide
articles.summary: At 14, Abhijay Potluri runs a nonprofit called Kids Who Teach and has taught coding to kids in four countries. He also helped raise money for families after a fire near his Massachusetts home.
